info.title: eBrief REST API - Swagger UI
info.description:
eBrief combines electronic communication with the classic form of a letter. Companies and private customers are in a position to produce their entire mail online and thus make mailing processes faster, more cost-effective and more efficient. Individual communication and high mailing volumes can be uploaded and processed electronically. The recipient receives a classic physical letter and all further steps -from processing the data to printing and delivery - are taken over by PINAG. To use REST API, you have to possess the valid Customer account.
Our eBrief-Support-Team can provide you with the needed credentials to use the REST-API. Please contact them support@ebrief.de
For a detailed api-documentation visit here: https://www.ebrief.de/api-dokumentation
Following are some further information for processing documents

List of attributes for processing an document

IsDuplex - Default: false; defines if printing is on both sides of the paper
IsColor - Default: false; defines if printing is in color or black/white
IsTracking - Default: false; defines if the shipment is trackable after printing/enveloping; should be used after eBrief-Support-Contact; different pricing e.g.
EnvelopeFormat - Shall only be used, when a document should be sent as a C4-Format, no matter how many pages the documents have; otherwise not to be used, only accepted value ""C4"")
AdressCheck - Default: true; defines if an adresscheck should me made.It will be checked, if ZIP-Code and city are fitting
Franking - possible values 'tiny' for DataMatrixCode; 'none' for a print without a barcode; if no value is delivered a barcode with type Interleaved 2/5 will be printed
SilentConfirm - Default: false; defines if the job should be confirmed separately for printing, or be confirmed without additional check and request
NotificationMail - It is possible to get an additional email-notification, when distribution of job is completed, value is an email-address
EnvelopeType - Only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact
PaperType - Only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact
PageRemovalRegex - Only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact; removes pages from a document.
DocumentsMergeRegex - Only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact; merges multiple separate documents.

List of job statuses and short explanation

UNPROCESSED - Processing of job not yet startet, adding documents to the job is still possible. Only relevant when batching of documents is used
COMITTED - Job has been released for further processing
ROLLEDBACK - Job has been rolled back.Document(s) will not be printed and send
PROCESSING_DOCUMENTS_PREPARE - Documents in the order are prepared (PDFs will be generated, converted)
COMPLETED_DOCUMENTS_PREPARE - Preparation of documents are completed.
PROCESSING_DOCUMENTS_PROCESS - Document(s) in the job are processed(addresscheck, barcode applied, Barcodeaufbringung etc.)
COMPLETED_DOCUMENTS_PROCESS - Processing of document(s) in the job are completed
USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED - Job is in a state that requires user intervention(documents not fully processable)
USER_WAIT_FOR_SHOPPING - Job needs to be confirmed for further processing and releasing to distribution(printing, enveloping)
USER_WAIT_FOR_PAYMENT- Job needs confirmation for processed payment(only valid and needed for webcustomers)
DISTRIBUTION_READY_FOR - Job is confirmed for distribution of the document(s) for printing and enveloping
DISTRIBUTION_COMPLETED - Document(s) in the job are transfered to printing facility and are ready for printing and enveloping
BILLING_COMPLETED - Billing data has been transfered to ERP-System for invoicing
JOB_COMPLETED - Job is finalized, no more updates will follow
ERROR_DOCUMENT - Document(s) in the job are erroneous
ERROR_GENERAL - An error occured during processing of the job
USER_DELETED - Job is deleted by User, no printing or invoicing
ERROR_LIMIT_EXCEEDED - Job has reached the monthly User limits, cancelled by processing

List of document statuses and short explanation

PREPARED - Document is being prepared for processing
UNPROCESSED - Processing not yet triggered for the document
PROCESSED - Document is converted into a PDF-File
MERGED - If the attribute for merging documents is given, it happens in this status
ADRESS_EXTRACTED - The address of the document is read and compared with the address database
WARNING_USER_INTERACTION_REQUIRED - There were errors verifying the address.The user can ignore this error or exclude the affected documents from processing
BARCODE_COLLECTED - A tracking number is reserved and attached to the document
ARTICLE_COLLECTED - With the existing parameters such as number of pages, print properties, address, the corresponding article and price are determined
OK - Document is successfully processed and waits for further distribution
USER_DELETED - Document was deleted by the user. Document is not printed and billed
USER_IGNORED - User ignored the address verification warning
IN_DELIVERY - The document is packed into a ZIP-file with print parameters (and other associated documents) for delivery to the print service provider
COMPLETED - The whole process around the document for distributing is complete

List of event statuses to a document and short explanation

DOCUMENT_CREATED - Document is being prepared for processing
DOCUMENT_DELIVERED - Document/Shipment was delivered(only for trackable shimpents)
DOCUMENT_IN_DELIVERY - Document/Shipment in delivery(only for trackable shipments)
DOCUMENT_PRINTER_WRAPPED - Document was printed and enveloped.
DOCUMENT_PROCESSED - Document is converted into a PDF-File
DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_ADDRESS_EXTRACTING - Address of the document was extracted and read
DOCUMENT_REGISTERED_AT_SORTINGMACHINE - Document/Shipment was registered at sortingcentre after printing and enveloping
DOCUMENT_SENT_BACK - Document/Shipment was not deliverable
DOCUMENT_TRANSFERRED_TO_PARTNER - Document/Shipment was given to shipment carrier
DOCUMENT_TRANSFERRED_TO_PRINTER - Document was given to print service provider


Webhook


You can avoid pulling API by providing a webhook-url to our eBrief-Support-Team.
If so, we will POST to provided web_hook_url whenever job changes its state.
To ensure that your API received, understood and accepted the request, we will check your response status code. With response status code other than 2xx we assume that request has failed.
The webhook body contains exactly the same fields as the response body from GET/jobs-request.
Keep in mind that the order of the webhook requests is not guaranteed, though usually they are ordered by the timestamp of the status change.

post.summary: Creates a job-id for single or multiple documents in a batch
post.description:
Creates a job-id for single or multiple documents in a batch.
Attributes for processing the document can be set here.The files for that batch needs to be posted separately and the job comitted for starting to process.

requestBody.description:
Attributes for the processing needs to be provided, following attributes are possible
"IsDuplex": "false" (Default: false; defines if printing is on both sides of the paper)
"IsColor": "false" (Default: false; defines if printing is in color or black/white)
"IsTracking": "false" (Default: false; defines if the shipment is trackable after printing/enveloping; should be used after eBrief-Support-Contact; different pricing e.g.)
"EnvelopeFormat": "C4" (Shall only be used, when a document should be sent as a C4-Format, no matter how many pages the documents have; otherwise not to be used)
"AdressCheck": "false" (Default: true; defines if an adresscheck should me made.It will be checked, if ZIP-Code and city are fitting)
"SilentConfirm": "true" (Default: false; defines if the job should be confirmed separately for printing, or be confirmed without additional check and request)
"NotificationMail": "test@test.com" (it is possible to get an additional email-notification, when job is completed)
"EnvelopeType" (only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact)
"PaperType" (only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact)
"PageRemovalRegex" (only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact)
"DocumentsMergeRegex" (only to be used after eBrief-Support-Contact)
"Reference": optional string, max 50 characters; customer reference for filtering jobs (e.g. user/mandant). Can be used in searchJobDetails.
"AdditionalReference": optional string, max 50 characters; additional customer reference for filtering jobs. Can be used in searchJobDetails.
